headlines.title: FDA approves 1st mRNA flu shot, from Moderna
headlines.description: The vaccine, called mFlusiva, was approved for older adults. In trials, it was found to be about 27% more effective than a standard flu shot.

headlines.title: Coverage for GLP-1 denied after weight loss
headlines.description: In our series “The Cost of Denial” NBC News’ Liz Kreutz reports on the debate over when and how to cover popular weight loss drugs, especially after a patient sheds the pounds. Should GLP-1s be covered as maintenance drugs?

headlines.title: Salmonella outbreak expands to 27 states
headlines.description: The CDC is reporting that there are more than 300 cases of salmonella across the country. At least 36 people have been hospitalized. Both Chipotle and Qdoba say they have removed jalapenos from all restaurants. NBC News’ Anne Thompson has more on what you need to know.

headlines.title: Chipotle Removes Jalapeños Tied to Salmonella Outbreak
headlines.description: The CDC now confirms more than 10,000 cases of cyclospora infections across 47 states. It comes as health officials in Minnesota are now investigating a wave of salmonella, with a vast majority of patients having recently eaten jalapeño peppers at Chipotle and other Mexican style restaurants. Chipotle says they “proactively removed” the jalapeños in question and “replaced them” with products from different growers. NBC’s Anne Thompson reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Chipotle removes jalapeños over salmonella concerns
headlines.description: The restaurant chain said it replaced jalapeños with product from other growers. Chipotle reports jalapeños are used in guacamole, pico de gallo and more. Meanwhile, we have new reporting on more cases in that illness linked to lettuce. NBC News’ Anne Thompson has the story.

headlines.title: Millions of eggs have been recalled due to Salmonella contamination — here’s how to stay safe
headlines.description: A multistate salmonella outbreak linked to eggs has sickened nearly one hundred people. Learn the symptoms, risks, and simple steps to protect your family from infection.

headlines.title: The best rolling backpacks for school, travel and work

headlines.title: New CDC director is confirmed, giving agency its first permanent leader in a year
headlines.description: Dr. Erica Schwartz, who was deputy surgeon general in Trump’s first term, inherits a measles crisis and a growing cyclosporiasis outbreak.

headlines.title: Cyclosporiasis outbreak has expanded to six more states
headlines.description: A massive cyclosporiasis outbreak linked to shredded iceberg lettuce has expanded to an additional six states, according to a source familiar with the matter.
